definitions.explanation: Doing something at once, sooner than others do: the first to react, notice, or adopt something. Common in news and business writing, often in praise of a quick response.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いち{早|はや}く{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: He was the first to notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いち{早|はや}く⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The fire department rushed to the scene right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧いち{早|はや}く⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れて→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧、⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧になった。
examples.english: That company adopted the new technology ahead of everyone else and became the industry leader.

notes:
Also written {逸早|いちはや}く. Stronger than ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (early, quickly): it implies being first, or quicker than others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- いち{早|はや}く⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧: to rush to the scene at once
- いち{早|はや}く⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧: to be quick to adopt
- いち{早|はや}く⟦{察知|さっち}→察知：21208_sacchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sense something before others
- いち{早|はや}くお⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliver promptly (in advertising)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{先|さき}→真っ先：07783_massaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: first of all — stresses being first in order
- ⟦{素早|すばや}い→素早い：17093_subayai⟧: quick, nimble — an adjective for speed of movement
